hero.title: Nursing in Finland
hero.subtitle: If you are planning to Study Nursing in Finland, the country offers internationally oriented nursing programmes, modern clinical training, and pathways towards working as a registered nurse.

overview: For Indian students, studying nursing in Finland can provide exposure to a modern European healthcare system, simulation-based learning, and multicultural clinical environments. However, applicants should carefully understand tuition fees, Finnish language requirements, eligibility criteria, and professional licensing before choosing a programme.
Edu-Hawk Worldwide helps students explore international education opportunities and understand the university selection, admission, and study-abroad planning process.

seo.title: Nursing in Finland for Indian Students | Edu-Hawk Worldwide
seo.description: Study Nursing in Finland: English-taught and bilingual Bachelor of Health Care, top UAS universities (Laurea, Metropolia), clinical training, fees and licensing for Indian students.
